Olivia P.: Hi team, new hire here. I can connect to the VPN (split-tunnel) and SSH to the bastion, but internal hostnames like `git.internal.redwood` don't resolve from my laptop. I can access that host by IP: `curl http://10.13.7.22/` works. MacBook Pro, macOS 13. Any quick advice?
Chris (infra): welcome Olivia! sounds like the VPN profile isn't pushing the internal DNS search or resolver. Quick test: what does `scutil --dns` show?
Olivia P.: ran `scutil --dns` and it only shows my ISP resolvers. Not sure how to change the VPN client profile.
Sam (devex): we see this a lot with split-tunnel to avoid routing all traffic. Two quick unblocks: 1) add a temporary /etc/hosts entry mapping `git.internal.redwood` -> 10.13.7.22, or 2) use an SSH tunnel through the bastion for services. Hosts is fastest if it's a single host.
Olivia P.: hosts is fine for now — what's the exact line? I'm nervous about sudo.
Chris (infra): run: `echo "10.13.7.22 git.internal.redwood" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts` then `ping git.internal.redwood` should resolve. Remember to remove it after.
Olivia P.: did that, ping now resolves. But `git clone git.internal.redwood:repo.git` still times out. SSH port 22?
Sam (devex): if the git server is only accessible inside the VPC you can create an ssh jump: `ssh -J olivia@bastion.redwood.internal git@git.internal.redwood` or add an ssh config entry: `Host git.internal.redwood
  ProxyJump olivia@bastion.redwood.internal`. That will route your git over the bastion.
Olivia P.: added ProxyJump in `~/.ssh/config` and clone started, nice!
deploy-bot: (system) bastion session established for olivia, audit id: b7e5a
Olivia P.: one more thing — when I switch networks the hosts entry will be wrong. Do I need to flush DNS after removing it?
Chris (infra): removing the /etc/hosts line is immediate for name resolution; on mac you can run `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder` to be safe.
Olivia P.: thanks, will do. Also, any plan to change the split-tunnel config so future hires don't need hosts edits?
Chris (infra): yes we have a ticket (INF-4310) to add the internal DNS suffix and push DNS servers for split-tunnel clients. Sam, can you link the onboarding doc?
Sam (devex): done — added a short HOWTO to the onboarding checklist and linked INF-4310. For people on BYOD we still recommend SSH jump or port-forwarding rather than altering system trust.
Olivia P.: super helpful, appreciate the quick responses. If I hit anything else I'll ping here. :wave:
